source_annotations.description: Manual head-echo ROI labels from range-time-Doppler matched-filter products.

doppler_model: f_D = (f0/c) * (u_tx + u_rx) dot v, positive for increasing bistatic path length

trajectory_fit_weighting.description: single-pass range/Doppler weighting using fixed nominal range and Doppler standard deviations

linearized_fit_error.covariance_model: heteroskedasticity-robust sandwich covariance using finite-difference physical Jacobian, final range/Doppler residuals, and fixed nominal range/Doppler weights

sandwich_covariance_details.covariance_model: heteroskedasticity-robust sandwich covariance using finite-difference physical Jacobian, final range/Doppler residuals, and fixed nominal range/Doppler weights
